items.title: Coles and Opoku-Fordjour among 25 England players given enhanced contracts
items.description: Alex Coles and Asher Opoku-Fordjour are among five England players to be awarded an enhanced contract by the RFU for the first time.

items.title: Draper in line to meet Djokovic at Cincinnati Open
Fery feels 'no added pressure' despite being British No 1 as he returns
items.description: Arthur Fery insists he feels “no added pressure” as the new British No 1 prepares to return to action this weekend for the first time since his memorable run to the Wimbledon semi-finals.

items.title: Vikings confirm Murray as starting QB
Villa close in on Atletico defender Ruggeri
items.description: Aston Villa close in on the signing of Atletico Madrid defender Matteo Ruggeri.

items.title: Messi unsure he will play 'much longer' after father's death
items.description: Lionel Messi says he is unsure how much longer he will continue playing football in an emotional tribute after his father's death.

items.title: Inter in advanced talks for Spurs full-back Spence
items.description: Inter Milan are in advanced talks to sign Tottenham and England full-back Djed Spence, in a deal worth a minimum of £25.6m (30m euros).

items.title: Everton's Sherif charged with 61 alleged bets on matches
items.description: The Football Association charges Everton's Martin Sherif with breaching betting rules after allegedly placing 61 bets on football matches.

items.title: Root removes England curfew
items.description: Joe Root has ruled out a curfew under his England Test captaincy and implored his players to behave like "grown adults" ahead of his first series back at the helm against Pakistan.

items.title: South Korea crisis deepens over sexual favours for referees scandal
items.description: The South Korean FA apologises amid a series of controversies and a police raid on its headquarters.

items.title: La Liga to inspect Celta Vigo's pitch after fungus outbreak
items.description: La Liga officials are set to inspect the pitch at Celta Vigo's Estadio de Balaidos over a suspected fungus outbreak.

items.title: Dubois on collision course with Turkish rival? MVP announce Turhan signing
items.description: Caroline Dubois could settle her rivalry with Elif Nur Turhan after the Turkish world champion signed for Most Valuable Promotions.
